newsitem.title: POLAND: Amerbank sets issue price at PLN 23.
newsitem.headline: Amerbank sets issue price at PLN 23.

text.p: The initial issue price of the 1.5 million new shares on offer later this month of Polish Bank Amerykanski w Polsce SA (Amerbank) was set at 23 zlotys each, the bank's deputy president said on Monday.

"The issue's price is 23 zlotys but it might be changed three or four days before the subscripton according to the share's market price, banks' market prices and overall market performance," Wlodek Paszkowski told Reuters.
On Friday Amerbank closed at 22.3 zlotys

Last month the Polish Securities Commission cleared for public trade the ex-rights issue for which investors can register from September 23 to September 27. The issue will be valid if at least 600,000 shares are sold.
The bank plans to use the proceeds to expand its lending operations, upgrade its computer system and possibly invest in minority stakes of other Polish banks.

Paszkowski said the bank would fulfil its 1996 profit forecasts of 13.3 million zlotys pre-tax and eight million net. Last year the bank had a pre-tax profit of 10.1 million zlotys and a net of 6.5 million.
